title: Houston Building Atlas Data Ecosystem & Provenance Catalog
subtitle: Declarative registry of all municipal, county, state, federal, academic, and archival institutions integrated or planned for cross-checking Houston building history and demolition risk
maintenanceNote: Add or update any institution or data feed in this JSON file (app/public/data/data_sources_catalog.json). Both the interactive screen explorer and the printable 24x36 architectural blueprint poster in app/data-ecosystem.html render automatically from this catalog.

statusDefinitions.label: Active Automated Feed
statusDefinitions.description: Fetched and cross-checked automatically by scheduled GitHub Actions pipelines (daily 7:00 AM CT sweeps, biweekly agenda builds, or annual roll refreshers) or live browser REST queries.

statusDefinitions.label: Active Curated / Archival Corpus
statusDefinitions.description: Digitized, geocoded, and indexed into the production Atlas shards from archival books, directories, historic maps, and preservation surveys.

statusDefinitions.label: Assisted Staff Cross-Check (1-Click Portal)
statusDefinitions.description: Integrated into the 15-Point Watchlist and Property Drawer with pre-filled search terms and one-click clipboard copy for portals gated by session tokens or CAPTCHAs.

statusDefinitions.label: In-Flight Public Records / Archive Order
statusDefinitions.description: Formal archival reproduction order or Texas Public Information Act (TPIA) bulk request submitted; parser and schema ready for ingestion upon delivery.

statusDefinitions.label: Not Used Yet (Planned Roadmap)
statusDefinitions.description: Identified high-value institutional dataset not yet ingested into the app, with a concrete technical plan and target milestone for integration.

frequencyBuckets.label: Daily 7:00 AM CT Automated Sweep
frequencyBuckets.description: Queried every morning at 7:00 AM Central Time via GitHub Actions to detect new demolition permits, sewer disconnects, asbestos notices, HCAD ownership transfers, and HAHC filings.

frequencyBuckets.label: Biweekly Planning Commission Cycle
frequencyBuckets.description: Ingested every two weeks ahead of and following City of Houston Planning Commission meetings (Plat Tracker spreadsheets, Section K variances, agenda outlines, and post-meeting minutes).

frequencyBuckets.label: Monthly / Live Browser GIS Query
frequencyBuckets.description: Refreshed monthly via bulk exports or queried live in the browser when inspecting a parcel on the map or Watchlist.

frequencyBuckets.label: Quarterly & Annual Certified Roll
frequencyBuckets.description: Synchronized with HCAD's annual certified appraisal roll (July/August) with October/November correction supplements, plus quarterly state/federal historic registry updates.

frequencyBuckets.label: Indexed Archival & Historic Corpus
frequencyBuckets.description: Multi-decade historical datasets (1866-1959 City Directories, 1905-1951 HMRC Building Permits, Sanborn Maps, and architectural surveys) indexed into static lookup shards.

frequencyBuckets.label: On-Demand Staff Cross-Check (HITL)
frequencyBuckets.description: Pre-formatted one-click search pills in the 15-Point Watchlist that copy target addresses, HCAD IDs, or LLC names for immediate lookup in session-gated portals.

frequencyBuckets.label: In-Flight Orders & Planned Ingestion
frequencyBuckets.description: Datasets currently being acquired via Harris County Archives reproduction orders, TPIA bulk requests, or scheduled Phase 2-4 pipeline expansions.

sectors.name: 1. County Appraisal, Tax & Real Property Records
sectors.description: Harris Central Appraisal District (HCAD), Harris County Archives, Harris County Clerk, and Tax Assessor-Collector records governing parcel boundaries, building dates, deeds, and historic tax rolls.

sectors.name: 2. City of Houston Planning, Permitting & Code Enforcement
sectors.description: Planning & Development (Plat Tracker, Planning Commission, Historic Preservation / HAHC), Houston Permitting Center (iPermits / ILMS), Public Works GIS, and Department of Neighborhoods.

sectors.name: 3. State & Federal Environmental, Corporate & Historic Agencies
sectors.description: Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS asbestos notifications), Texas Comptroller, Secretary of State, Texas Historical Commission (THC), National Park Service (NRHP), FEMA, and USGS.

sectors.name: 4. Special Collections, City Directories & Historic Cartography
sectors.description: Houston Public Library HMRC, Morrison & Fourmy / Polk City Directories (1866-1959), Library of Congress & UT Dolph Briscoe Center Sanborn Fire Insurance Maps, Rice University Fondren Library, and Wikimedia Commons.

sectors.name: 5. Preservation Houston & Civic Architectural Research
sectors.description: Preservation Houston curated landmarks, Good Brick Awards, Lost Houston demolition registry, AIA Houston architectural guides, Houston Mod, and Houston Architecture Info Forum (HAIF).

sectors.name: 6. Spatial Basemaps, Aerial Imagery & Cloud Sync Infrastructure
sectors.description: Esri World Imagery parcel aerials, Google Maps Street View, OpenFreeMap / CARTO vector basemaps, and the 13-tab Google Sheets + Apps Script 3-way cloud synchronization hub.

synthesisEngines.name: Construction Date Integrity & Rounding Override Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Detects HCAD placeholder decade defaults (1900, 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950) and cross-checks City Directories, HMRC building permits, Sanborn maps, and Harris County Archives tax rolls to establish verified construction years.

synthesisEngines.name: 6-Tier Ownership Unmasking & Chain-of-Title Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Builds multi-decade ownership chains (2005-2026 HCAD certified rolls + Clerk deeds), unmasks Texas Tax Code Sec. 25.025 Current Owner shields, and links shell LLCs across portfolios using mailing addresses and Texas Comptroller / SOS officer records.

synthesisEngines.name: 8-Agency Daily Demolition & Early-Warning Sweep Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Runs daily at 7:00 AM CT across COH structural demo permits, water/wastewater disconnects, DSHS asbestos abatement notices, HAHC COA filings, HCAD deeds, and Dangerous Building hearing orders, enforcing Two-Key confirmation before graduating buildings to Lost Houston.

synthesisEngines.name: Biweekly Subdivision Plat Triage & Cross-Cycle Continuity Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Cross-checks biweekly Planning Commission Plat Tracker spreadsheets, Agenda Outline PDFs (including Section K Development Plat Variances), and Post-Meeting Minutes against pre-1976 buildings, historic districts, and watched developers, consolidating repeat filings across cycles.

synthesisEngines.name: Resident Genealogy, Contractor & Sanborn Evolution Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Links 39 Houston City Directory volumes (1866-1959) via dual pass (Street Guide + Alphabetical Resident Directory) with 1905-1951 HMRC building permits, historic street renumbering (1911), and Sanborn Fire Insurance Map footprints.

synthesisEngines.name: Landmark, Historic District & Preservation Status Engine
synthesisEngines.summary: Reconciles City of Houston Protected Landmarks, City Landmarks, 22 local Historic Districts, National Register (NRHP) properties, Recorded Texas Historic Landmarks (RTHL), and Good Brick Award winners to determine legal demolition protection vs. unprotected risk.

organizations.name: Harris Central Appraisal District (HCAD)
organizations.overview: Primary appraisal authority for 1.18M+ Harris County real property accounts, providing parcel geometry, CAMA structural characteristics, building permits, and annual certified ownership rolls from 2005 through 2026.

feeds.name: HCAD CAMA Real & Building Bulk Extracts (real_acct, building_res, building_other)
feeds.method: Bulk Tab-Delimited ZIP Download & DuckDB PostGIS Pipeline
feeds.recordScale: 1.18M parcels / 1.44M buildings
feeds.whatItProvides: Account numbers, site addresses, erection dates (date_erected / yr_impr), square footage, structural type, exterior wall materials, CDU/grade ratings, and legal descriptions.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checked against City Directories and HMRC permits to flag rounded decade placeholder dates (1900, 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950) and overridden via date_overrides.json.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production; automated annual roll refresher checks pdata.hcad.org each July/August and applies October/November correction supplements.

feeds.name: HCAD Historical Certified Ownership Rolls (2005-2026 Archive)
feeds.method: Multi-Year CAMA Archive Ingestion & Entity Normalization
feeds.recordScale: 22 annual snapshots (~24M historical account-year rows)
feeds.whatItProvides: Year-by-year recorded property owners, mailing addresses, acquisition dates (new_own_dt), and assessed values from 2005 to 2026.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Used to construct continuous chain-of-title timelines and to unmask post-2021 Texas Tax Code Sec. 25.025 'Current Owner' privacy shields using pre-shield historical rolls.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production across all 699,664 parcel shards; refreshed annually.

feeds.name: HCAD Public Parcels & Residential Grade ArcGIS FeatureServer
feeds.frequencyLabel: Daily 7:00 AM CT Sweep + Real-Time Browser Query
feeds.method: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer JSON/GeoJSON Query
feeds.recordScale: Live query across 1.18M parcels (28 watched properties swept daily)
feeds.whatItProvides: Live owner_name_1, owner_name_2, deeds_date (exact acquisition date), mail_addr_1, state_class, land_value, total_appraised_val, and parcel polygon centroids.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Overrides Plat Tracker applicant/engineer names on the Watchlist so Row 5 always records the true HCAD property owner and actual deed acquisition date rather than sweep date.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production both in daily Python sweeps and live client-side browser enrichment.

feeds.name: HCAD CAMA Historical & Recent Permit File (permits.txt)
feeds.method: Bulk Tab-Delimited Permit Extract Sharded by HCAD Prefix
feeds.recordScale: 1.9M+ permit records across 256 prefix shards
feeds.whatItProvides: Permit issue dates, permit types, docket numbers, and remodel/addition/demolition indicators tracked by HCAD appraisers.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checked with City of Houston iPermits and HMRC 1905-1951 building permits to separate demolition permits from remodels.

organizations.name: Harris County Archives
organizations.overview: Custodian of pre-HCAD Harris County historical records, including CR051 Appraisal Field Cards (1930s-1970s), CR037 Tax Assessor-Collector Block Books (1914-1981), and CR067 Tax Assessment Rolls.

feeds.name: CR051 Real Property Appraisal Field Cards (1930s-1970s, Series B0223)
feeds.frequencyLabel: In-Flight Archive Order (B0223 Pilot Submitted Nov 2026)
feeds.method: Archival PDF Reproduction Order + Structured OCR Card Parser
feeds.recordScale: Pilot: 5 Sunset Heights & Key St parcels; Microfilm: 1966-1974 reels
feeds.whatItProvides: Original pre-1984 tax appraiser field inspection cards containing physical building sketches, footprints, exact construction dates, porch additions, and historic photographs before HCAD's 1984 computerization rounded dates to 1920/1930/1940.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Custom Reproduction Order Form B0223 submitted in November 2026 for 1127 Key St and 4 neighbor comparison lots (Sunset Heights Blk 28/29). Upon PDF delivery from Harris County Archives, extract dates/sketches into date_overrides.json and Property Drawer History cards, then expand to microfilm reels for priority historic neighborhoods in Q1 2027.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Directly resolves discrepancies where HCAD CAMA defaults to 1920 or 1930 while City Directories show earlier or later construction.

feeds.name: CR037 Tax Assessor-Collector Block Books (1914-1981, 562 Volumes)
feeds.method: Reading Room Digital Camera Capture + Subdivision/Block/Lot Table Extractor
feeds.recordScale: 562 bound volumes & microfilm reels organized by Subdivision, Block, and Lot
feeds.whatItProvides: Annual lot-by-lot assessed land value vs. improvement value from 1914 to 1981, pinpointing the exact tax year an unimproved vacant lot jumped in value because a house or commercial building was erected, plus owner names for every year.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checks 1926-1931 gap years between City Directory editions (such as 1926 vs 1927 vs 1928) by verifying the exact year improvement value first appeared on the county tax roll.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Not used yet. Harris County Archives confirmed on November 11, 2026 that CR037 Block Books (1914-1981) are open for self-service photography at 1310 Prairie St. Planned for Phase 2 (Q1 2027): photograph targeted subdivision block pages for Houston Heights, Sunset Heights, Montrose, Freedmen's Town, and Eastwood, then parse year-over-year improvement value jumps.

organizations.name: Harris County Clerk (Real Property, Probate & Assumed Names)
organizations.overview: Official recorder of deeds, deeds of trust, mechanic's liens (builders contracts), plats, probate estates, and DBA assumed name certificates in Harris County from 1836 to the present.

feeds.name: Address-Indexed Deed & Grantor/Grantee Chain Lookup Shards
feeds.frequencyLabel: Indexed Shards + Assisted Portal Deep Links
feeds.method: Gzipped Address-Prefix Shards + Pre-Filled Clerk Search Helper
feeds.recordScale: 699,664 parcel chains + 1-click Clerk RP/Probate/DBA links
feeds.whatItProvides: Historical grantor/grantee transfers, instrument numbers, file dates, and pre-formatted search helpers for Real Property, Probate, and Assumed Name (DBA) records.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Combined with HCAD new_own_dt and Texas SOS filings to trace property transfers through trusts, estates, and shell entities.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production; expanding bulk pre-2005 index coverage via pending TPIA bulk index request.

feeds.name: TPIA Bulk Real Property Grantor/Grantee Index (1960-2004 & Builders Liens)
feeds.method: Texas Public Information Act (Ch. 552) ASCII/CSV Index Export
feeds.recordScale: Multi-million row historical instrument index (no PDF image fees)
feeds.whatItProvides: Complete machine-readable index of pre-2005 deeds and historic Mechanic's Lien / Builders Contract filings that name the original builder/architect and exact contract price.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Bridges the gap between 1959 (last indexed City Directory) and 2005 (earliest online HCAD CAMA roll) so every building has an unbroken 20th-century ownership chain.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: TPIA request staged in November 2026 requesting the tabular Grantor/Grantee + Legal Description index database export under Texas Gov't Code Sec. 552.275. Will be ingested into app/public/data/ownership_chains/ as soon as the Clerk's IT bureau provides the CSV/SQL dump.

organizations.name: Harris County Tax Assessor-Collector
organizations.overview: Collects property taxes for Harris County and City of Houston taxing jurisdictions; records unredacted taxpayer billing names, payment dates, and tax delinquency/foreclosure suits.

feeds.name: Tax Statement Billing Name & Delinquency Verification
feeds.method: 1-Click Account Copy + Direct Statement Portal Link
feeds.recordScale: All 1.18M Harris County tax accounts
feeds.whatItProvides: Unmasked billing taxpayer names on current tax statements (often visible even when HCAD web display shows 'Current Owner') and multi-year tax delinquency status.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Used as Tier 3 of the 6-Tier Ownership Unmasking protocol when HCAD's public CAMA display suppresses an individual owner's name.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production via 1-click Watchlist & Property Drawer verification links.

organizations.name: Harris County District Clerk (Tax Suits, Receiverships & Eminent Domain)
organizations.overview: Records civil litigation, delinquent property tax foreclosure lawsuits, municipal receivership actions, and highway/transit eminent domain condemnation dockets.

feeds.name: Delinquent Tax Foreclosure, Nuisance Abatement & Condemnation Suit Lookup
feeds.method: Monthly Delinquent Tax Sale List Ingestion + Party/Address Matcher
feeds.recordScale: Monthly Constable & District Court tax sale dockets
feeds.whatItProvides: Early notice when a historic building enters tax foreclosure, court-ordered receivership, or public right-of-way condemnation before a speculative buyer acquires it at auction.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Will cross-check monthly Harris County Constable tax sale parcels against pre-1976 buildings and Watchlist items.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Not used yet. Planned for Phase 3 (Q2 2027) by ingesting the monthly Harris County Precinct tax sale parcel lists and matching HCAD account numbers against the Atlas.

organizations.name: City of Houston Planning & Development (Plat Tracker & Planning Commission)
organizations.overview: Administers Chapter 42 subdivision replats, lot splits, variances, special exceptions, and development plats across Houston and its ETJ on a biweekly Planning Commission schedule.

feeds.name: Biweekly Plat Tracker Spreadsheets (.xlsx / .csv)
feeds.frequencyLabel: Biweekly Planning Commission Cycle + Manual Drop-Zone
feeds.method: Automated Python Pipeline + Browser XLSX/CSV Parser
feeds.recordScale: 727 filings across 3 active cycles (716 consolidated properties)
feeds.whatItProvides: Application numbers, subdivision names, application types, special requests (variances/reconsiderations), HCAD account numbers, acreage, lot counts, developer/applicant names, and Super Neighborhoods.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Every parcel is spatially and account-matched against the Atlas's 1.44M buildings to flag pre-1976 structures, lot splits (1 lot into 2-4 townhome lots), reserve consolidations, Historic Districts, and repeat developers.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production; supports both automated pipeline ingestion and instant drag-and-drop .xlsx/.csv upload in plat-monitor.html.

feeds.name: Planning Commission Agenda Outline PDFs (incl. Section K Development Plat Variances)
feeds.frequencyLabel: Biweekly PC Agenda Publication (Fridays before PC Meeting)
feeds.method: PDF Text Extraction & Section Parser (Sections I-K)
feeds.recordScale: 100-250 agenda items per biweekly meeting
feeds.whatItProvides: Official agenda item numbers, public hearing flags, staff recommendations (Approve/Defer), and Section K Development Plat Variances (DPVs) which are omitted from Plat Tracker spreadsheets.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Diffs the published Agenda Outline PDF against the Plat Tracker cycle spreadsheet to mark which filings are actually on the meeting agenda vs. 'Cycle Filing Only - Not on Agenda'.

feeds.name: Planning Commission Post-Meeting Draft & Approved Minutes PDFs
feeds.method: PDF Commission Action Parser & Cross-Cycle Linker
feeds.recordScale: All historical & current PC cycle appearances
feeds.whatItProvides: Official Commission actions taken at each prior meeting (Approved, Deferred 2 Weeks, Withdrawn, Disapproved, or Cycle Filing Only - Not on Agenda).
feeds.howCrossChecked: Linked across cycles by HCAD account, canonical plat name, and street address so repeat deferrals show the actual Commission action taken at each prior meeting date rather than repeating manual notes.

organizations.name: City of Houston Office of Historic Preservation & HAHC
organizations.jurisdiction: City of Houston (22 Historic Districts & Landmarks)
organizations.overview: Houston Archaeological and Historical Commission (HAHC) and Office of Historic Preservation regulating Certificates of Appropriateness (COAs), Protected Landmarks, City Landmarks, and 22 Historic Districts.

feeds.name: HAHC Certificate of Appropriateness (COA) Monthly Agenda & Action Tracker
feeds.frequencyLabel: Daily 7:00 AM CT Sweep + Monthly HAHC Cycle
feeds.method: ArcGIS FeatureServer & HAHC Agenda Scraper
feeds.recordScale: 1,400+ COA filings (2020-2026 YTD) + District Action Summaries
feeds.whatItProvides: Alteration, addition, new construction, relocation, and demolition COA filings across Houston's 22 historic districts, including staff recommendations and HAHC decisions.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Matched by HCAD account and normalized street address against watched properties and compared against citywide structural demolitions to measure historic district protection efficacy.

feeds.name: COH Historic Districts, Protected Landmarks & Archaeological Sites GIS Layers
feeds.frequencyLabel: Monthly GIS Sync + Static GeoJSON Overlay
feeds.method: COH ArcGIS FeatureServer Export to GeoJSON
feeds.recordScale: 22 Historic Districts + 450+ City & Protected Landmarks
feeds.whatItProvides: Official polygon boundaries of Houston's 22 Historic Districts, SMLS/SMBL conservation lots, and point/polygon locations of City Landmarks and Protected Landmarks.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Spatial point-in-polygon intersection during Pass 1 Plat Screening and Map Tile generation to distinguish legally protected landmarks from unprotected landmarks.

organizations.name: Houston Permitting Center (HPC iPermits, Weekly XLS & ILMS)
organizations.overview: Issues building, structural demolition, remodel, trade, and water/wastewater utility permits and hosts the Integrated Land Management System (ILMS) plan review portal.

feeds.name: COH Structural Demolition & Building Permits Feed (Weekly XLS + Open Data API)
feeds.method: COH ArcGIS REST API + Weekly Sold Permits XLS Ingestion
feeds.recordScale: 3,900+ structural demo permits (2020-2026 YTD) + active building permits
feeds.whatItProvides: Project numbers, permit numbers, issue dates, permit descriptions ('DEMO RES/BLDG', 'REMODEL', etc.), and contractor names.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Translated into plain-English risk badges via permitPlainEnglish.js; requires Two-Key corroboration (permit + post-permit imagery/field check or HCAD improvement drop) before marking a building Demolished.

feeds.name: Water / Wastewater Utility Disconnect & Tap Permits
feeds.frequencyLabel: Daily 7:00 AM CT Automated Sweep + Assisted iPermits Check
feeds.method: Permit Keyword Classifier ('SEWER DISCONNECT', 'PLUG', 'CAP') + 1-Click Portal
feeds.recordScale: Swept daily across all watched properties & pre-1976 alert parcels
feeds.whatItProvides: Early-warning utility disconnect permits that frequently precede a formal structural demolition permit by 2 to 6 weeks.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Correlated with DSHS asbestos abatement notifications and Plat Tracker filings to trigger Tier 1 escalation.

feeds.name: ILMS Plan Review & Project Number Portal
feeds.method: 1-Click Project Number / Address Copy + Direct ILMS Portal Launch
feeds.recordScale: All active Houston commercial & residential plan reviews
feeds.whatItProvides: Architectural plan review status, trade review holds, and scope of proposed site work once a project number is obtained from Row 2 Building Permits.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Placed directly below Row 2 (Building Permits Search) in the Plans & Use category so staff can copy a project number from Row 2 straight into Row 3 (ILMS).

organizations.name: City of Houston Public Works & GIMS / COHGIS
organizations.overview: Maintains Houston's municipal GIS layers including Super Neighborhoods, City Council Districts, TIRZ boundaries, Special Minimum Lot Size (SMLS), and Special Minimum Building Line (SMBL) protections.

feeds.name: Super Neighborhoods, Council Districts, TIRZ & SMLS/SMBL Protection Layers
feeds.frequencyLabel: Monthly GIS Boundary Sync + Daily SMLS Sweep
feeds.method: ArcGIS FeatureServer Spatial Intersection
feeds.recordScale: 88 Super Neighborhoods, 11 Council Districts, 600+ SMLS/SMBL blocks
feeds.whatItProvides: Neighborhood context, Council District representation, and Chapter 42 SMLS/SMBL lot-split protection status.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Flags plat applications located near or within SMLS/SMBL blocks where minimum lot size rules can block townhome replats.

feeds.name: Joint Referral Committee (JRC) Street & Easement Abandonment Requests
feeds.frequencyLabel: On-Demand Watchlist Check (Row 12) + Council Agenda Scan
feeds.method: 1-Click Portal Check + Council Motion Keyword Match
feeds.recordScale: Watchlist Row 12 (Public Works / Utilities / Easements)
feeds.whatItProvides: Requests to abandon public alleys, streets, or utility easements required before assembling multi-block redevelopment reserves.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checked with multi-lot reserve replats on the Planning Commission agenda.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active as an assisted check; automated JRC agenda PDF scraping planned for Q2 2027.

organizations.name: City of Houston Department of Neighborhoods (DON & 311 Dangerous Buildings)
organizations.overview: Investigates dangerous/substandard buildings, Structural Standards code violations, heavy trash/nuisance citations, and administrative hearing demolition orders.

feeds.name: COH 311 Structural Standards & Dangerous Buildings Feed + CSV Matcher
feeds.frequencyLabel: Daily 7:00 AM CT Sweep + Instant CSV Drop-Zone Matcher
feeds.method: COH 311 Open Data API + In-Browser Dangerous Buildings CSV Parser
feeds.recordScale: Daily sweep of watched parcels + bulk CSV cross-check against 1.44M buildings
feeds.whatItProvides: Open dangerous building investigations, hearing notices, and emergency city-ordered demolition filings.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Matches 311 / DON case addresses and HCAD IDs against pre-1976 structures and generates a one-click staff alert summary.

organizations.name: Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS Asbestos Program)
organizations.overview: Requires mandatory 10-working-day advance notification before any commercial or public building demolition or asbestos renovation/abatement in Texas.

feeds.name: DSHS Asbestos Demolition & Abatement Notification Feed
feeds.method: Texas Open Data Portal Socrata API + Assisted DSHS Search
feeds.recordScale: All Houston / Harris County commercial abatement & demo notices
feeds.whatItProvides: Facility names, street addresses, abatement start/end dates, demolition start dates, and operator/contractor names at least 10 working days before wrecking begins.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Frequently provides the earliest public confirmation of an impending commercial or institutional demolition prior to City of Houston permit issuance.

organizations.name: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts & Secretary of State (SOSDirect)
organizations.overview: Maintains Texas taxpayer records, Public Information Reports (PIRs), officers, directors, registered agents, and governing person filings for LLCs, LPs, and corporations.

feeds.name: Texas Comptroller Sales Taxpayer Search, Franchise Tax & SOS Entity Unmasking
feeds.frequencyLabel: Automated Portfolio Clustering + 1-Click Taxpayer & Franchise Portals
feeds.method: Entity Name/Address Normalization + Pre-Filled Taxpayer Search Pills
feeds.recordScale: 85,000+ corporate/LLC parcels clustered across Harris County
feeds.whatItProvides: Governing principals, registered agents, managing members, and shared tax mailing addresses behind single-purpose acquisition LLCs, with corporate suffix commas stripped automatically so LLCs are never split in two.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Links seemingly unrelated shell LLCs (e.g. '123 Main LLC' and '456 Oak Holdings LLC') that share a registered agent or suite address into a single developer portfolio.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Active in production; Sales Taxpayer Search placed at top of Row 6 above Franchise Tax Account Status per staff workflow.

organizations.name: Texas Historical Commission (THC Historic Sites Atlas)
organizations.overview: State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) administering Recorded Texas Historic Landmarks (RTHLs), State Antiquities Landmarks (SALs), Historical Markers, and Historic Texas Cemeteries.

feeds.name: Recorded Texas Historic Landmarks (RTHL), SALs & Historical Markers GIS
feeds.method: THC Atlas Shapefile / ArcGIS Ingestion + Parcel Matching
feeds.recordScale: 350+ Harris County RTHLs, SALs, markers, and historic cemeteries
feeds.whatItProvides: State-level historic designations, marker narratives, and 60-day RTHL/SAL notice protections.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checked with City of Houston landmark status and ETJ rural tract plat filings to warn of historic cemeteries and farmsteads.

organizations.name: National Park Service (National Register of Historic Places / NRHP)
organizations.overview: Official federal list of districts, sites, buildings, structures, and objects significant in American history and architecture, qualifying income-producing properties for Historic Tax Credits.

feeds.name: NRHP Listed Buildings, Districts & Nomination Metadata
feeds.frequencyLabel: Quarterly NRHP Spatial & Reference Number Sync
feeds.method: NPS Cultural Resources GIS + Curated Nomination Narratives
feeds.recordScale: 220+ individual NRHP listings & historic districts in Harris County
feeds.whatItProvides: NRHP reference numbers, listing dates, architect/builder attributions, periods of significance, and district contributing/non-contributing boundaries.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Combined with City of Houston Protected Landmark records to flag NRHP buildings that are eligible for federal/state rehabilitation tax credits but lack municipal demolition protection.

organizations.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer & USGS 3DEP / Historical Topographic Maps
organizations.overview: Federal Emergency Management Agency 100-year and 500-year floodplains / floodways and US Geological Survey lidar elevation and historical 1915-1982 topographic quadrangles.

feeds.name: FEMA 100-Year / 500-Year Floodplain & Bayou Floodway Risk Overlay
feeds.method: FEMA NFHL ArcGIS REST Service + Parcel Flood Zone Tagging
feeds.recordScale: Countywide floodplain zones (AE, X, Floodway) across 22 watersheds
feeds.whatItProvides: Identifies whether a historic building sits inside a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area or floodway where Substantial Damage (>50% market value) rules trigger elevation or demolition pressure.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Will cross-check post-storm remodel/repair permits and elevation variances against pre-1976 historic housing stock.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Not used yet. Planned for Phase 3 (Q2 2027) using Harris County Flood Control District (HCFCD) / FEMA MAAPnext effective polygons.

organizations.name: Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ Central Registry & Dry Cleaner / PST Remediation)
organizations.overview: Tracks Voluntary Cleanup Program (VCP) sites, Innocent Owner/Operator certificates, Underground Storage Tank (PST) removals, and Brownfield redevelopment filings.

feeds.name: TCEQ Voluntary Cleanup Program (VCP) & Underground Tank Removal Filings
feeds.method: TCEQ GIS / Open Data REST Query + Address Matcher
feeds.recordScale: Historic gas stations, auto showrooms, dry cleaners, and industrial warehouses
feeds.whatItProvides: Detects Phase I/II environmental cleanup and tank pull registrations that frequently precede commercial tract assembly and historic industrial/retail demolition by 3 to 9 months.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Will cross-check TCEQ VCP and PST site registrations against pre-1976 commercial and industrial buildings.
feeds.howAndWhenPlanned: Not used yet. Planned for Phase 4 (Q3 2027) via TCEQ Open Data GIS endpoints to give earlier warning on historic industrial, warehouse, and mid-century commercial properties.

organizations.name: Houston Public Library - Houston Metropolitan Research Center (HMRC)
organizations.jurisdiction: City of Houston (Julia Ideson Building Special Collections)
organizations.overview: Premier municipal archive holding City of Houston Building Permit Ledgers (1905-1951), historic Morrison & Fourmy / Polk City Directories, architectural drawings, and photographic collections.

feeds.name: HMRC Historic City of Houston Building Permits (1905-1951)
feeds.method: OCR Ledger Extraction + 1911 Street Renumbering & Address Normalization
feeds.recordScale: 42,000+ historic building permits & 3,800+ indexed contractors/architects
feeds.whatItProvides: Original building permit numbers, exact filing dates, owner at construction, builder/contractor name, architect name, number of rooms/stories, and construction cost in historic dollars.
feeds.howCrossChecked: Cross-checked with HCAD erection dates and City Directories to prove exact construction dates and attribute previously uncredited builders and architects.

feeds.name: HMRC Digital Archive Photographs & Texas Room Vertical Files
feeds.frequencyLabel: Curated Archival Corpus + Watchlist Research Links
